bio: Fleekz reps Montego Bay, Jamaica — part of the new wave of Jamaican artists blending island roots with alt-rap, alongside CWI labelmate Dre50. He first surfaced on the CWI radar as the artist behind “2K23 Corner$,” verified under the Appears On section of That Boy Hi Hat’s official Spotify page. His full catalog and story are being confirmed — this page grows as the details land. (Verified profile link pending — multiple same-name profiles exist and must not be confused with him; Black is supplying confirmed details.)
